classification: runtime-confirmed Linux ARM64 KVM bug; not maintainer-confirmed or upstream-accepted
finding: KVM_ARM_MTE_COPY_TAGS reaches a base-page MTE helper for a fresh untagged hugetlb folio

static_detection.control: The fixed scan used the same Kbuild mapping and complete translation unit with only patch 4 changed.

environment.guest_features: ARM64 MTE; all CPUs at EL2; KVM VHE; two preallocated 2 MiB hugepages

shared_artifacts.artifact_policy: Generated kernels, binaries, initramfs, and full serial logs are intentionally not tracked.

runs.name: vulnerable
runs.failure: VM_WARN_ON_ONCE at arch/arm64/include/asm/mte.h:58 in kvm_vm_ioctl_mte_copy_tags; panic_on_warn then panics the host kernel
runs.interpretation: A valid tag-read ioctl on a fresh hugetlb memslot calls page_mte_tagged(), which is invalid for hugetlb pages.

runs.name: fixed
runs.interpretation: The same ioctl selects only the hugetlb folio helper and completes without a warning or panic.

control: The trigger, init, initramfs, QEMU command, machine, CPU, memory, and kernel configuration were identical; only patch 4 differed between kernels.
limitations: TCG exercises ARM64 MTE, EL2, and KVM behavior but is not physical ARM64 hardware coverage.
The reproducer covers one fresh anonymous 2 MiB hugetlb memslot and one tag-read ioctl.
The other three patches in the adjacent MTE series remain static candidates without this runtime confirmation.
Linux KVM maintainer review and upstream acceptance remain pending.
